messages:
elaine-security: Jen (auditor) asked for an evidence bundle that maps incident artifacts to SOC2/ISO control IDs, plus proof of export identity, KMS key usage, and file hashes.

sam-sre: Do we want to show both an automated nightly dump and a single manual export as examples?

elaine-security: Yes — auditor wants one of each. Key asks: manifest with sha256 per file, signer info, cloudtrail event for assume-role, and the KMS DescribeKey + rotation history.

maria-eng: Automated exporter writes to s3://redwood-evidence/auto/YYYY-MM-DD/. Each bundle includes export-manifest.json and export-manifest.sig. We sign manifests with our HSM key; manifests embed the wrapping_key_alias when envelope encryption is used.

sam-sre: Retention summary to include: hot logs 90 days, evidence buckets lifecycle to Glacier/Deep Archive at 30 days, and archive retention policy 3 years. I'll attach the lifecycle JSON.

auditor-jen: For private deployments using customer-managed keys, we need the wrapped DEK blob and the CMK id so we can validate encryption provenance. Also want a redacted approval ticket for the manual export.

maria-eng: For Private we include wrapped_dek_b64 and wrapping_key_id in the manifest. Manual exports require an on-call approval ticket; the export stores the approver id in manifest.triggered_by.

opsbot: export job 0x5e9a started by svc-evidence-exporter at 2026-03-05T12:41:18Z job-id=0x5e9a

sam-sre: We'll pull the cloudtrail event for sts:AssumeRole and the iam:CreatePresignedUrl event (if uploading to customer buckets).

elaine-security: Also provide vuln triage evidence: a triage.json that records ticket, commit SHA, image digest, SBOM path, and CI run URL. Auditor wants proof that the commit is GPG-signed and PR approvals are recorded.

maria-eng: We can include a redacted Buildkite run URL and the git show -s --format=%G? output to prove GPG status, plus registry manifest for image digest and SBOM path.

auditor-jen: Bundle requested: (1) manual export manifest + signature + redacted approval ticket + cloudtrail snippet; (2) automated export manifest + lifecycle policy + KMS rotation record; (3) vuln triage sample with commit, PR metadata, CI link, image manifest and SBOM; (4) short README mapping each file to control IDs and the exact CLI queries used.

elaine-security: Action items: Maria: assemble both manifests, signature files, and KMS DescribeKey output. Sam: pull cloudtrail snippets and lifecycle JSON. I'll draft the README control mapping (target CC6.1/6.2/6.5 and ISO A.9/A.12).

maria-eng: Uploading sample bundle to temp evidence bucket and will share presigned URL with auditor-jen. ETA 4 hours.

opsbot: export job 0x5e9a status=completed exit=0 duration=00:00:12 artifacts=4 manifest=s3://redwood-evidence/manual/bundle-2026-03-05/export-manifest.json

auditor-jen: Thanks — presigned link should be fine. I'll validate hashes and mapping once received.

elaine-security: Noted. We'll file a follow-up ticket to add a console feature that creates signed, single-use evidence bundles (PLAT-1290).

sam-sre: +1 on automation. Will make future audits less manual.

auditor-jen: Appreciate it, team. I'll ping if I need any clarifications. :thumbsup:
